group.name: Choose the build matching your SkyrimSE.exe version

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.104
plugin.description:
For SkyrimSE.exe 1.7.104.0 (current Steam release). Requires SKSE64 2.3.1 and Address Library for SKSE Plugins v13 (versionlib-1-7-104-0.bin).
To check your version, right-click SkyrimSE.exe in the game folder, choose Properties, then Details, and read File version. The plugin refuses to load on any other version.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.6.1170
plugin.description:
For SkyrimSE.exe 1.6.1170.0 (the previous Anniversary Edition release, often kept by downgraded or modlist installs). Requires SKSE64 2.2.6 and Address Library for SKSE Plugins v11 (versionlib-1-6-1170-0.bin).
To check your version, right-click SkyrimSE.exe in the game folder, choose Properties, then Details, and read File version. The plugin refuses to load on any other version.
